# Create function to convert monthly to yearly NetCDF


```{r}
monthly_to_yearly_nc <- function(
    base_dir, model, scenario, variable,
    ensemble = "r1i1p1f1", resolution = "30arcmin",
    period = "2101_2300", units_override = NULL,
    surface_only = TRUE
) {
  
  # Had to include this conditional because vo data for 2101_2300 was too big to fit on Enterprise 
  input_base_dir <- if (period == "2101_2300" & variable == "vo") {
    "/Volumes/fkt260629do/ipsl-cm6a-lr"
  } else {
    base_dir
  }
  
  input_file <- file.path(
    input_base_dir, model, scenario,
    sprintf(
      "%s_%s_%s_%s_%s_global_monthly_%s.nc",
      model, ensemble, scenario, variable, resolution, period
    )
  )
  # 
  # input_file <- file.path(base_dir, model, scenario,
  # sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s_%s_global_monthly_%s.nc",
  #         model, ensemble, scenario, variable, resolution, period))
  
  output_dir <- file.path(base_dir, model, scenario, "yearly")
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir,
                           sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s_%s_global_yearly_%s.nc",
                                   model, ensemble, scenario, variable, resolution, period))
  
  if (!file.exists(input_file)) stop("Input file not found:\n", input_file)
  
  var_nc <- variable
  if (variable %in% c("o2-bot", "ph-bot", "so-bot")) var_nc <- sub("-bot$", "", variable)
  
  nc <- nc_open(input_file)
  on.exit(nc_close(nc), add = TRUE)
  
  lon  <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon")
  lat  <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat")
  time <- ncvar_get(nc, "time")
  
  time_units <- ncatt_get(nc, "time", "units")$value
  origin_year <- as.integer(sub(".*since ([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", time_units))
  years <- origin_year + floor(time / 12)
  uyears <- sort(unique(years))
  
  var_units <- nc$var[[var_nc]]$units
  if (!is.null(units_override)) var_units <- units_override
  
  var_dims <- sapply(nc$var[[var_nc]]$dim, function(x) x$name)
  
  if (surface_only && length(var_dims) == 4) {
    lev_pos <- which(grepl("^olevel", var_dims))
    time_pos <- which(var_dims == "time")
    
    if (length(lev_pos) != 1 || length(time_pos) != 1) {
      stop("Could not identify level/time dimensions for ", var_nc, ": ",
           paste(var_dims, collapse = ", "))
    }
    
    start <- rep(1, length(var_dims))
    count <- rep(-1, length(var_dims))
    count[lev_pos] <- 1
    
    surface_array <- ncvar_get(nc, var_nc, start = start, count = count)
    surface_array <- drop(surface_array)
    
  } else {
    surface_array <- ncvar_get(nc, var_nc)
    surface_array <- drop(surface_array)
  }
  
  yearly_means <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(length(lon), length(lat), length(uyears)))
  
  for (i in seq_along(uyears)) {
    idx <- which(years == uyears[i])
    yearly_means[,,i] <- apply(surface_array[,,idx], c(1,2), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  lon_dim  <- ncdim_def("lon",  "degrees_east",  lon)
  lat_dim  <- ncdim_def("lat",  "degrees_north", lat)
  year_dim <- ncdim_def("year", "year", uyears)
  
  var_def <- ncvar_def(
    name = variable,
    units = var_units,
    dim = list(lon_dim, lat_dim, year_dim),
    missval = -999,
    prec = "float"
  )
  
  nc_out <- nc_create(output_file, vars = list(var_def))
  ncvar_put(nc_out, var_def, yearly_means)
  nc_close(nc_out)
  
  message("Yearly surface NetCDF written:\n", output_file)
  invisible(output_file)
}

```

```{r}
merge_early_late_nc <- function(path_early, path_late, path_future, out_dir) {
  library(ncdf4)
  library(abind)
  
  # --- Open files ---
  nc_early  <- nc_open(path_early)
  nc_late   <- nc_open(path_late)
  nc_future <- nc_open(path_future)
  
  on.exit({
    try(nc_close(nc_early), silent = TRUE)
    try(nc_close(nc_late), silent = TRUE)
    try(nc_close(nc_future), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  # --- Read coordinates ---
  lon <- ncvar_get(nc_early, "lon")
  lat <- ncvar_get(nc_early, "lat")
  
  # --- Identify main variable ---
  exclude_vars <- c("lon", "lat", "time", "time_var", "olevel", "olevel_bnds", "bnds")
  candidate_vars <- setdiff(names(nc_early$var), exclude_vars)
  
  if (length(candidate_vars) == 0) {
    stop("No suitable data variable found in ", path_early)
  }
  
  varname <- candidate_vars[1]
  
  # --- Inspect dimensions of target variable ---
  var_dims <- sapply(nc_early$var[[varname]]$dim, function(x) x$name)
  
  # --- Helper function to read variable ---
  read_target_var <- function(nc, varname) {
    dims <- sapply(nc$var[[varname]]$dim, function(x) x$name)
    
    if (identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "time"))) {
      
      data <- ncvar_get(nc, varname)
      return(drop(data))
    }
    
    if (identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "olevel", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "olevel", "time"))) {
      
      lon_n  <- nc$dim[[dims[1]]]$len
      lat_n  <- nc$dim[[dims[2]]]$len
      lev_n  <- nc$dim[[dims[3]]]$len
      time_n <- nc$dim[[dims[4]]]$len
      
      if (lev_n < 1) stop("No olevel dimension found in ", varname)
      
      data <- ncvar_get(
        nc, varname,
        start = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
        count = c(lon_n, lat_n, 1, time_n)
      )
      
      return(drop(data))
    }
    
    stop(
      "Unsupported variable dimensions for ", varname, ": ",
      paste(dims, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # --- Read data ---
  data_early  <- read_target_var(nc_early,  varname)
  data_late   <- read_target_var(nc_late,   varname)
  data_future <- read_target_var(nc_future, varname)
  
  # --- Confirm arrays are now lon x lat x time ---
  if (length(dim(data_early)) != 3 ||
      length(dim(data_late))  != 3 ||
      length(dim(data_future)) != 3) {
    stop("After reading, arrays are not 3D lon x lat x time.")
  }
  
  # --- Merge along time dimension ---
  data_full <- abind(data_early, data_late, data_future, along = 3)
  
  # --- Build time vector from actual inputs ---
  time_early  <- if ("time_var" %in% names(nc_early$var)) ncvar_get(nc_early, "time_var") else ncvar_get(nc_early, "time")
  time_late   <- if ("time_var" %in% names(nc_late$var))  ncvar_get(nc_late, "time_var")  else ncvar_get(nc_late, "time")
  time_future <- if ("time_var" %in% names(nc_future$var)) ncvar_get(nc_future, "time_var") else ncvar_get(nc_future, "time")
  
  time_full <- c(time_early, time_late, time_future)
  
  if (length(time_full) != dim(data_full)[3]) {
    stop(
      "Time length mismatch: time vector = ", length(time_full),
      ", data time dimension = ", dim(data_full)[3]
    )
  }
  
  # --- Time variable name for output ---
  out_time_name <- "time"
  
  # --- Time units and calendar from source if available ---
  time_units <- NA
  time_calendar <- NA
  
  if ("time" %in% names(nc_early$dim)) {
    time_units <- ncatt_get(nc_early, "time", "units")$value
    time_calendar <- ncatt_get(nc_early, "time", "calendar")$value
  } else if ("time_var" %in% names(nc_early$dim)) {
    time_units <- ncatt_get(nc_early, "time_var", "units")$value
    time_calendar <- ncatt_get(nc_early, "time_var", "calendar")$value
  }
  
  if (is.null(time_units) || is.na(time_units)) time_units <- "unknown_time_units"
  
  # --- Define dimensions ---
  dim_lon  <- ncdim_def("lon", "degrees_east", lon, create_dimvar = TRUE)
  dim_lat  <- ncdim_def("lat", "degrees_north", lat, create_dimvar = TRUE)
  dim_time <- ncdim_def("time", time_units, time_full, unlim = TRUE, create_dimvar = TRUE)
  
  # --- Define output variables ---
  fillvalue <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname, "_FillValue")$value
  if (is.null(fillvalue) || is.na(fillvalue)) fillvalue <- -9999
  
  var_units <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname, "units")$value
  if (is.null(var_units) || is.na(var_units)) var_units <- "unknown"
  
  var_data <- ncvar_def(
    varname,
    var_units,
    list(dim_lon, dim_lat, dim_time),
    missval = fillvalue,
    prec = "double"
  )
  
  var_time <- ncvar_def(
    out_time_name,
    time_units,
    list(dim_time),
    missval = NULL,
    prec = "double"
  )
  
  # --- Output name ---
  basename_early <- basename(path_early)
  outname <- basename_early
  
  outname <- gsub("_historical_", "_", outname, fixed = TRUE)
  outname <- gsub("_30arcmin_global_yearly_1850_2014.nc", "_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc", outname)
  outname <- gsub("_30arcmin_global_monthly_1850_2014.nc", "_monthly_1850_2300_05x05.nc", outname)
  outname <- paste0("merged_", outname)
  
  path_merged <- file.path(out_dir, outname)
  
  # --- Create output file ---
  ncid <- nc_create(path_merged, list(var_time, var_data))
  
  ncvar_put(ncid, "lon", lon)
  ncvar_put(ncid, "lat", lat)
  ncvar_put(ncid, out_time_name, time_full)
  ncvar_put(ncid, varname, data_full)
  
  # --- Copy variable attributes ---
  var_atts <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname)
  for (nm in names(var_atts)) {
    if (!nm %in% c("_FillValue")) {
      ncatt_put(ncid, varname, nm, var_atts[[nm]])
    }
  }
  
  # --- Copy time calendar if available ---
  if (!is.null(time_calendar) && !is.na(time_calendar)) {
    ncatt_put(ncid, "time", "calendar", time_calendar)
  }
  
  # --- Copy global attributes ---
  gatts_early <- ncatt_get(nc_early, 0)
  for (nm in names(gatts_early)) {
    ncatt_put(ncid, 0, nm, gatts_early[[nm]])
  }
  
  nc_close(ncid)
  nc_close(nc_early)
  nc_close(nc_late)
  nc_close(nc_future)
  
  cat("Merged:", path_merged, "\n")
}

```

### Merge for uo

```{r}
merge_early_late_nc <- function(path_early, path_late, path_future, out_dir) {
  
  library(ncdf4)
  library(abind)
  
  # --- Open files ---
  nc_early  <- nc_open(path_early)
  nc_late   <- nc_open(path_late)
  nc_future <- nc_open(path_future)
  
  on.exit({
    try(nc_close(nc_early), silent = TRUE)
    try(nc_close(nc_late), silent = TRUE)
    try(nc_close(nc_future), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  # --- Read spatial coordinates ---
  lon <- ncvar_get(nc_early, "lon")
  lat <- ncvar_get(nc_early, "lat")
  
  # --- Identify main data variable ---
  exclude_vars <- c(
    "lon", "lat", "time", "time_var", "year",
    "olevel", "olevel_bnds", "bnds"
  )
  
  candidate_vars <- setdiff(names(nc_early$var), exclude_vars)
  
  if (length(candidate_vars) == 0) {
    stop("No suitable data variable found in: ", path_early)
  }
  
  varname <- candidate_vars[1]
  
  # --- Read a time/year coordinate from an input file ---
  read_time_coord <- function(nc) {
    
    if ("time_var" %in% names(nc$var)) {
      return(ncvar_get(nc, "time_var"))
    }
    
    if ("time" %in% names(nc$dim)) {
      return(nc$dim[["time"]]$vals)
    }
    
    if ("year" %in% names(nc$dim)) {
      return(nc$dim[["year"]]$vals)
    }
    
    stop(
      "No supported temporal coordinate found. Available dimensions: ",
      paste(names(nc$dim), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # --- Read 3D data or first ocean level of 4D data ---
  read_target_var <- function(nc, varname) {
    
    dims <- sapply(nc$var[[varname]]$dim, function(x) x$name)
    
    # Variables already stored as lon x lat x time/year
    if (identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "year")) ||
        identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "time_var")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "year")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "time_var"))) {
      
      return(drop(ncvar_get(nc, varname)))
    }
    
    # Variables stored as lon x lat x olevel x time/year
    if (identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "olevel", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "olevel", "year")) ||
        identical(dims, c("lon", "lat", "olevel", "time_var")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "olevel", "time")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "olevel", "year")) ||
        identical(dims, c("longitude", "latitude", "olevel", "time_var"))) {
      
      lon_n    <- nc$dim[[dims[1]]]$len
      lat_n    <- nc$dim[[dims[2]]]$len
      lev_n    <- nc$dim[[dims[3]]]$len
      period_n <- nc$dim[[dims[4]]]$len
      
      if (lev_n < 1) {
        stop("No ocean-level dimension found for variable: ", varname)
      }
      
      data <- ncvar_get(
        nc,
        varname,
        start = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
        count = c(lon_n, lat_n, 1, period_n)
      )
      
      return(drop(data))
    }
    
    stop(
      "Unsupported dimensions for ", varname, ": ",
      paste(dims, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # --- Read data arrays ---
  data_early  <- read_target_var(nc_early, varname)
  data_late   <- read_target_var(nc_late, varname)
  data_future <- read_target_var(nc_future, varname)
  
  # --- Confirm lon x lat x period arrays ---
  if (length(dim(data_early)) != 3 ||
      length(dim(data_late)) != 3 ||
      length(dim(data_future)) != 3) {
    stop("After reading, one or more arrays are not 3D: lon x lat x period.")
  }
  
  # --- Merge across the temporal dimension ---
  data_full <- abind(data_early, data_late, data_future, along = 3)
  
  # --- Merge coordinate vectors ---
  time_early  <- read_time_coord(nc_early)
  time_late   <- read_time_coord(nc_late)
  time_future <- read_time_coord(nc_future)
  
  time_full <- c(time_early, time_late, time_future)
  
  if (length(time_full) != dim(data_full)[3]) {
    stop(
      "Time-length mismatch: coordinate vector has ", length(time_full),
      " values but merged data has ", dim(data_full)[3],
      " temporal layers."
    )
  }
  
  # --- Retrieve temporal metadata ---
  source_time_dim <- if ("time" %in% names(nc_early$dim)) {
    "time"
  } else if ("time_var" %in% names(nc_early$dim)) {
    "time_var"
  } else if ("year" %in% names(nc_early$dim)) {
    "year"
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  time_units <- "year"
  time_calendar <- NA_character_
  
  if (!is.null(source_time_dim)) {
    
    source_units <- ncatt_get(nc_early, source_time_dim, "units")$value
    source_calendar <- ncatt_get(nc_early, source_time_dim, "calendar")$value
    
    if (!is.null(source_units) &&
        length(source_units) == 1 &&
        !is.na(source_units)) {
      time_units <- source_units
    }
    
    if (!is.null(source_calendar) &&
        length(source_calendar) == 1 &&
        !is.na(source_calendar)) {
      time_calendar <- source_calendar
    }
  }
  
  # --- Retrieve data metadata ---
  fillvalue <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname, "_FillValue")$value
  if (is.null(fillvalue) || length(fillvalue) == 0 || is.na(fillvalue)) {
    fillvalue <- -9999
  }
  
  var_units <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname, "units")$value
  if (is.null(var_units) || length(var_units) == 0 || is.na(var_units)) {
    var_units <- "unknown"
  }
  
  # --- Define output dimensions ---
  dim_lon <- ncdim_def(
    name = "lon",
    units = "degrees_east",
    vals = lon,
    create_dimvar = TRUE
  )
  
  dim_lat <- ncdim_def(
    name = "lat",
    units = "degrees_north",
    vals = lat,
    create_dimvar = TRUE
  )
  
  dim_time <- ncdim_def(
    name = "time",
    units = time_units,
    vals = time_full,
    unlim = TRUE,
    create_dimvar = TRUE
  )
  
  # --- Define output data variable ---
  var_data <- ncvar_def(
    name = varname,
    units = var_units,
    dim = list(dim_lon, dim_lat, dim_time),
    missval = fillvalue,
    prec = "double"
  )
  
  # --- Construct output file name ---
  basename_early <- basename(path_early)
  
  outname <- basename_early
  outname <- gsub("_historical_", "_", outname, fixed = TRUE)
  outname <- gsub(
    "_30arcmin_global_yearly_1850_2014.nc",
    "_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc",
    outname
  )
  outname <- gsub(
    "_30arcmin_global_monthly_1850_2014.nc",
    "_monthly_1850_2300_05x05.nc",
    outname
  )
  
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  path_merged <- file.path(out_dir, outname)
  
  # --- Create output NetCDF ---
  ncid <- nc_create(path_merged, vars = list(var_data))
  
  # Dimension coordinate variables are automatically created by ncdim_def().
  ncvar_put(ncid, varname, data_full)
  
  # --- Copy data-variable attributes ---
  var_atts <- ncatt_get(nc_early, varname)
  
  for (nm in names(var_atts)) {
    if (!nm %in% c("_FillValue", "units")) {
      ncatt_put(ncid, varname, nm, var_atts[[nm]])
    }
  }
  
  # --- Add calendar attribute when supplied ---
  if (!is.na(time_calendar)) {
    ncatt_put(ncid, "time", "calendar", time_calendar)
  }
  
  # --- Copy global attributes ---
  global_atts <- ncatt_get(nc_early, 0)
  
  for (nm in names(global_atts)) {
    ncatt_put(ncid, 0, nm, global_atts[[nm]])
  }
  
  # --- Close output file ---
  nc_close(ncid)
  
  cat("Merged:", path_merged, "\n")
  
  invisible(path_merged)
}

```

```{r}



test_plot <-function(path_merged){
  
  nc <- nc_open(path_merged)
  
  if(nc$nvars == 2){
    var_name <- nc$var[[2]]$name
  }else{
    var_name <- nc$var[[1]]$name
  }
  
  pH   <- ncvar_get(nc, var_name)   # 720 x 360 x 300
  
  if(var_name %in% c("uo","vo")){
  time <- ncvar_get(nc, "time") # 300‑element vector  
  }else(
    time <- ncvar_get(nc, "time_dim") # 300‑element vector
  )
  
  
  nc_close(nc)
  
  # --- Compute global mean over space at each time ---
  pH_mean <- apply(pH, 3, function(tt) mean(tt, na.rm = TRUE))  # time‑slice means
  
  # --- Make a data frame ---
  df <- data.frame(
    year = time,                 # assuming your "yyyy" is just numeric year
    pH   = pH_mean
  )
  
  # --- Optional: remove missing values ---
  df <- df[!is.na(df$pH), ]
  
  # --- Fit linear trend ---
  fit <- lm(pH ~ year, data = df)
  
  # --- Plot with trend line ---
  ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = pH)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Global mean variable (1850–2300)",
      x = "Year",
      y = "pH"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(1850, 2300),
      breaks = seq(1850, 2300, by = 50)
    ) # format y-axis with commas
  
  ggsave(
    last_plot(),
    filename = paste0("/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined_figures/", var_name, "_global_mean_trend.jpg"),
    width = 8, height = 5)
  
}

path_list <- list.files("/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined",pattern = ".nc",full.names = T)


test_plot(path_list[14])

lapply(path_list, test_plot)
```

# Transform totaplhy2 

```{r}

# Calculates totalphy2 based on available phytoplankton size classes from different ESMs

# Read diatom production data
diat_nc <- nc_open("/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined/ipsl-cm6a-lr_r1i1p1f1_intppdiat_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc")

npp_nc <- nc_open("/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined/ipsl-cm6a-lr_r1i1p1f1_intpp_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc")

diat <- ncvar_get(diat_nc, "intppdiat")
npp  <- ncvar_get(npp_nc,  "intpp")

lon <- ncvar_get(diat_nc, "lon")
lat <- ncvar_get(diat_nc, "lat")
year <- ncvar_get(diat_nc, "time_dim")

nc_close(diat_nc)
nc_close(npp_nc)

diaz <- npp - diat
totalphy2 <- diaz * 0.1 + diat
totalphy2[totalphy2 < -9999] <- -9999  

lon_dim <- ncdim_def("lon", "degrees_east", lon)
lat_dim <- ncdim_def("lat", "degrees_north", lat)
year_dim <- ncdim_def("time_dim", "year", year, unlim = FALSE)

missval <- -9999
phy_var <- ncvar_def(
  name = "totalphy2",
  units = "mmol N m-2 d-1",
  dim = list(lon_dim, lat_dim, year_dim),
  missval = missval,
  longname = "Total phytoplankton production from diat and diaz"
)

out_file <- "/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined/ipsl-cm6a-lr_r1i1p1f1_totalphy2_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc"
nc_out <- nc_create(out_file, phy_var)

ncvar_put(nc_out, phy_var, totalphy2)

ncatt_put(nc_out, 0, "source", "Derived from intppdiat and intpp")
ncatt_put(nc_out, 0, "history", paste("Created", Sys.time()))

nc_close(nc_out)

test_plot("/Volumes/Enterprise/Data/FishMip/fishmip_2300/ipsl-cm6a-lr/combined/ipsl-cm6a-lr_r1i1p1f1_totalphy2_yearly_1850_2300_05x05.nc")

```
